title: The Nomad Studio: event-driven, model-tiered worker hierarchy

W01.title: Junior Implementation and Alpha Draft Engineer
W01.activation: GitHub PR activity with authorized alpha stage
W01.role_contract: bounded approved code/boilerplate/tests only; compile & checkpoint; never invent ABI

W02.title: Senior Debugging Engineer
W02.activation: PR update/comment signaling verified failed CI or recorded defect
W02.role_contract: reproduce isolated failure, minimal repair, new final SHA, fresh CI; same job/branch

W03.title: Senior Integration Engineer
W03.activation: PR review/ready event with upstream jobs independently QA verified
W03.role_contract: stitch interfaces and branches, reconcile ABI/source boundaries, validate integration; no new features

W04.title: Independent Technical QA Engineer
W04.activation: PR ready/review event, immutable final commit
W04.role_contract: independent QA at exact SHA; never edit reviewed artifact

W05.title: Principal Integration and Architecture Escalation
W05.activation: owner-authorized high-risk escalation; not a permanently active task
W05.role_contract: cross-system ABI, memory, concurrency or repeated failures; report decision owner must approve
